name: Rainbow Canvas
description: Draggable 3D illustrated rainbow with soft clouds on a colored backdrop, drawn on a canvas with Zdog. It spins slowly on its own and pauses while dragged.
behavior: Drag to rotate freely, auto-spin pauses while dragging and resumes on release
Canvas scales down to fit narrow screens
editableByProps: Backdrop color, rainbow band colors and cloud colors
Size, zoom, band thickness, starting rotation and spin speed

needsCodeEdit.where: cloud1 shapes and copyGraph call inside the useEffect
width and height attributes on the canvas element

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Canvas is drawn at 800x480 and scaled down by CSS on small screens
